class: The same fact in another shape: a dial code read as a country
symptom: The agent "corrected" the phone's dial-code picker (labelled "Country", showing "+1") to "United States" on every pass, wasting a retry each time.
root_cause: A phone's country-code picker shows a dial code and is labelled "Country"; the residence-correction pass read the label and compared the dial code with the owner's country name.
why_tests_missed: The correction tests used real country lists, never a picker whose value is a dial code, and ran without the page observer that makes a site's value eligible for correction.
fix: A control showing only a dial code is skipped by correct_from_profile (_holds_dial_code).
prevention: Decide what a field asks from its value's shape as well as its label: a dial code answers a phone question, never a residence one.
